### Figure One Description
Figure 1 shows changes in the percentage of female and male U.S. high school students reporting persistent sadness or hopelessness from 2019 to 2023. Among female students, the percentage increased from 46.6% in 2019 to 56.6% in 2021, and decreased to 52.6% in 2023. Among male students, the percentages were relatively stable, increasing from 26.8% in 2019 to 28.6% in 2021 and then decreasing to 27.7% in 2023. Female students reported a higher percentage of persistent sadness or hopelessness than male students during all three survey years.
